plain.value: How the Quayside depot building, yard and staff side work.

pages.title: Quayside depot handbook
pages.body: Start here. The pages below cover the yard, the building and the people side of the Quayside depot.

pages.title: Visitor sign-in and escorts
pages.body: Every visitor signs in at reception, takes a lanyard and is escorted past the yellow line. Contractors also read the site rules card before starting work.

pages.title: Forklift pre-use checks
pages.body: Before the first lift of a shift check the forks, chains, mast, tyres, horn, lights, seat belt and battery level, and tick the clipboard by the charger.

pages.title: Lone working out of hours
pages.body: Anyone alone on site rings the duty manager on arrival and when leaving. The panic button by the transport office goes straight to the alarm company.

pages.title: Fire evacuation
pages.body: The assembly point is the far end of the staff car park. Fire wardens sweep the cold store corridor and the toilets before reporting at the assembly point.

pages.title: Booking annual leave
pages.body: Fill in the leave form on the HR drive and give it to your manager. December leave is agreed once the Christmas cover sheet is complete.

pages.title: Van keys and fuel cards
pages.body: Van keys live in the key safe in the transport office. Each fuel card stays with its van; report a lost card to the transport manager the same day.

pages.title: Clearing label printer jams
pages.body: Open the print head, pull the backing paper straight and close it firmly. If the red light flashes twice after that, raise a ticket in the IT helpdesk.

pages.title: Yard speed limit and one-way system
pages.body: Five miles an hour everywhere on site. Vans come in by the north gate and leave by the south gate, and nobody reverses across the pedestrian crossing.

pages.title: Cold store cleaning schedule
pages.body: Floors are scrubbed nightly, walls and racking weekly and drains monthly. The cleaning contractor signs the sheet on the cold store door each time.

pages.title: Uniform and PPE
pages.body: Safety boots, hi-vis and a fleece are issued on day one. Worn-out items are replaced free when you hand the old one back at stores.

pages.title: Charity quiz night 2026
pages.body: Friday 11 December in the canteen, in aid of the lifeboat station. Teams of up to six, two pounds a head, pasties at half time.
